appeals_decision_note_check.name: appeals_decision_note_check
appeals_decision_note_check.value: "appeals"."decision_note" is null or char_length("appeals"."decision_note") between 1 and 1000

archive_transfers_status_check.name: archive_transfers_status_check
archive_transfers_status_check.value:
("archive_transfers"."status"::text = 'awaiting_consent' and "archive_transfers"."completed_at" is null and "archive_transfers"."cancelled_at" is null and "archive_transfers"."snapshot" is not null)
        or ("archive_transfers"."status"::text = 'done' and "archive_transfers"."completed_at" is not null and "archive_transfers"."cancelled_at" is null and "archive_transfers"."snapshot" is null)
        or ("archive_transfers"."status"::text = 'cancelled' and "archive_transfers"."cancelled_at" is not null and "archive_transfers"."completed_at" is null and "archive_transfers"."snapshot" is null and "archive_transfers"."cancel_reason" is not null)

archive_transfers_target_check.name: archive_transfers_target_check
archive_transfers_target_check.value:
("archive_transfers"."target"::text = 'course_qa' and "archive_transfers"."course_id" is not null and "archive_transfers"."project_id" is null and "archive_transfers"."source_comment_id" is not null)
        or ("archive_transfers"."target"::text = 'stuck_log' and "archive_transfers"."project_id" is not null and "archive_transfers"."course_id" is null and "archive_transfers"."time_bucket" is not null)
        or ("archive_transfers"."target"::text = 'senior_note' and "archive_transfers"."course_id" is not null and "archive_transfers"."project_id" is null and "archive_transfers"."source_comment_id" is null)

archive_transfers_result_check.name: archive_transfers_result_check
archive_transfers_result_check.value:
"archive_transfers"."status"::text <> 'done'
        or ("archive_transfers"."target"::text = 'course_qa' and "archive_transfers"."course_qa_item_id" is not null)
        or ("archive_transfers"."target"::text = 'stuck_log' and "archive_transfers"."stuck_log_id" is not null)
        or ("archive_transfers"."target"::text = 'senior_note' and "archive_transfers"."senior_note_id" is not null)

case_studies_unavailable_check.name: case_studies_unavailable_check
case_studies_unavailable_check.value: ("case_studies"."status" = 'unavailable') = ("case_studies"."unavailable_at" is not null) and ("case_studies"."unavailable_reason" is null or "case_studies"."unavailable_reason" in ('withdrawn', 'replaced'))

claim_evidence_kind_check.name: claim_evidence_kind_check
claim_evidence_kind_check.value:
("claim_evidence"."log_entry_id" is not null and "claim_evidence"."log_revision_id" is not null and "claim_evidence"."artifact_version_id" is null)
        or ("claim_evidence"."log_entry_id" is null and "claim_evidence"."log_revision_id" is null and "claim_evidence"."artifact_version_id" is not null)

community_author_lookups_target_check.name: community_author_lookups_target_check
community_author_lookups_target_check.value: ("community_author_lookups"."target_type" = 'post' and "community_author_lookups"."post_id" is not null and "community_author_lookups"."comment_id" is null) or ("community_author_lookups"."target_type" = 'comment' and "community_author_lookups"."comment_id" is not null and "community_author_lookups"."post_id" is null)

community_comments_content_check.name: community_comments_content_check
community_comments_content_check.value:
("community_comments"."status" = 'deleted_by_author' and "community_comments"."body" = '' and "community_comments"."deleted_at" is not null)
        or ("community_comments"."status" <> 'deleted_by_author' and char_length("community_comments"."body") between 1 and 3000 and "community_comments"."deleted_at" is null)

community_notices_post_unread_key.name: community_notices_post_unread_key
community_notices_post_unread_key.where: "community_notices"."post_id" is not null and "community_notices"."read_at" is null

community_notices_subject_check.name: community_notices_subject_check
community_notices_subject_check.value: "community_notices"."space_id" is not null or "community_notices"."recruitment_id" is not null

community_posts_content_check.name: community_posts_content_check
community_posts_content_check.value:
("community_posts"."status" = 'deleted_by_author' and "community_posts"."title" = '' and "community_posts"."body" = '' and "community_posts"."deleted_at" is not null)
        or ("community_posts"."status" <> 'deleted_by_author' and char_length("community_posts"."title") between 1 and 120 and char_length("community_posts"."body") between 1 and 10000 and "community_posts"."deleted_at" is null)

community_sanctions_level_check.name: community_sanctions_level_check
community_sanctions_level_check.value: ("community_sanctions"."level" = 'write_suspended' and "community_sanctions"."until" is not null) or ("community_sanctions"."level" <> 'write_suspended' and "community_sanctions"."until" is null)

community_spaces_official_check.name: community_spaces_official_check
community_spaces_official_check.value: "community_spaces"."kind" not in ('official_school', 'official_department') or ("community_spaces"."school_id" is not null and "community_spaces"."current_name_mode" = 'anonymous')

community_spaces_department_check.name: community_spaces_department_check
community_spaces_department_check.value: ("community_spaces"."kind" = 'official_department') = ("community_spaces"."department_key" is not null) and ("community_spaces"."department_key" is null) = ("community_spaces"."department_label" is null)

consents_note_check.name: consents_note_check
consents_note_check.value: "consents"."note" is null or char_length("consents"."note") between 1 and 300

course_qa_items_content_check.name: course_qa_items_content_check
course_qa_items_content_check.value:
(char_length("course_qa_items"."question_title") between 1 and 120 and char_length("course_qa_items"."question_body") between 1 and 10000 and char_length("course_qa_items"."answer_body") between 1 and 3000)
        or ("course_qa_items"."status"::text = 'withdrawn' and "course_qa_items"."question_title" = '' and "course_qa_items"."question_body" = '' and "course_qa_items"."answer_body" = '')

embargoes_scope_target_check.name: embargoes_scope_target_check
embargoes_scope_target_check.value: ("embargoes"."scope" = 'project' and "embargoes"."project_id" is not null and "embargoes"."course_term_id" is null) or ("embargoes"."scope" = 'course_term' and "embargoes"."course_term_id" is not null and "embargoes"."project_id" is null)

endorsements_note_check.name: endorsements_note_check
endorsements_note_check.value: "endorsements"."note" is null or char_length("endorsements"."note") between 1 and 500

institution_affiliations_open_hash_check.name: institution_affiliations_open_hash_check
institution_affiliations_open_hash_check.value: "institution_affiliations"."method"::text <> 'email' or "institution_affiliations"."status" not in ('pending', 'active') or "institution_affiliations"."email_hash" is not null

institution_affiliations_revoked_check.name: institution_affiliations_revoked_check
institution_affiliations_revoked_check.value: "institution_affiliations"."status" <> 'revoked' or ("institution_affiliations"."revoked_at" is not null and "institution_affiliations"."revoked_reason" is not null)

moderation_actions_reversed_check.name: moderation_actions_reversed_check
moderation_actions_reversed_check.value: ("moderation_actions"."reversed_at" is null) = ("moderation_actions"."reverse_cause" is null) and ("moderation_actions"."reverse_cause" is null or "moderation_actions"."reverse_cause" in ('lift', 'appeal', 'space')) and ("moderation_actions"."reversed_at" is null or "moderation_actions"."kind" <> 'none')

moderation_actions_space_check.name: moderation_actions_space_check
moderation_actions_space_check.value: "moderation_actions"."kind"::text not in ('restrict_space', 'archive_space') or "moderation_actions"."community_space_id" is not null

moderation_actions_community_item_check.name: moderation_actions_community_item_check
moderation_actions_community_item_check.value: "moderation_actions"."kind"::text not in ('space_hide', 'sanction') or (("moderation_actions"."community_post_id" is null) <> ("moderation_actions"."community_comment_id" is null) and "moderation_actions"."community_space_id" is null)

moderation_actions_item_check.name: moderation_actions_item_check
moderation_actions_item_check.value: ("moderation_actions"."kind" <> 'hide_item') or ("moderation_actions"."item_kind" is not null and "moderation_actions"."item_key" is not null and "moderation_actions"."publication_id" is not null)

ops_time_entries_note_check.name: ops_time_entries_note_check
ops_time_entries_note_check.value: "ops_time_entries"."note" is null or char_length("ops_time_entries"."note") between 1 and 200

persona_activities_item_kind_check.name: persona_activities_item_kind_check
persona_activities_item_kind_check.value:
("persona_activities"."source_type" = 'publication_release' and "persona_activities"."item_kind" = 'cases')
        or ("persona_activities"."source_type" in ('senior_note', 'study_release') and "persona_activities"."item_kind" = 'notes_and_studies')
        or ("persona_activities"."source_type" in ('profile_post', 'community_post') and "persona_activities"."item_kind" = 'posts')

personas_display_name_check.name: personas_display_name_check
personas_display_name_check.value: ("personas"."kind" = 'real' and "personas"."display_name" is null) or ("personas"."kind" = 'display' and char_length("personas"."display_name") between 1 and 50)

profile_posts_body_check.name: profile_posts_body_check
profile_posts_body_check.value: ("profile_posts"."status" = 'deleted' and "profile_posts"."body" = '') or ("profile_posts"."status" <> 'deleted' and char_length("profile_posts"."body") between 1 and 500)

publication_candidates_release_check.name: publication_candidates_release_check
publication_candidates_release_check.value: ("publication_candidates"."release_no" is null) = ("publication_candidates"."published_at" is null) and ("publication_candidates"."release_no" is null or "publication_candidates"."release_no" >= 1)

recruitments_host_check.name: recruitments_host_check
recruitments_host_check.value: "recruitments"."space_id" is not null or "recruitments"."course_id" is not null

recruitments_term_course_check.name: recruitments_term_course_check
recruitments_term_course_check.value: "recruitments"."term_id" is null or "recruitments"."course_id" is not null

recruitments_title_check.name: recruitments_title_check
recruitments_title_check.value: char_length("recruitments"."title") between 1 and 80 or ("recruitments"."status"::text <> 'open' and "recruitments"."title" = '' and "recruitments"."description" = '')

reports_details_check.name: reports_details_check
reports_details_check.value: "reports"."details" is null or char_length("reports"."details") between 1 and 1000

reports_closed_check.name: reports_closed_check
reports_closed_check.value: ("reports"."status" in ('resolved', 'dismissed')) = ("reports"."closed_at" is not null and "reports"."action_id" is not null)

reports_item_key_check.name: reports_item_key_check
reports_item_key_check.value: "reports"."item_key" is null or char_length("reports"."item_key") between 1 and 64

reports_target_check.name: reports_target_check
reports_target_check.value:
("reports"."target_type" = 'publication' and "reports"."publication_id" is not null and "reports"."release_id" is not null and "reports"."item_kind" is null)
        or ("reports"."target_type" = 'publication_item' and "reports"."publication_id" is not null and "reports"."release_id" is not null and "reports"."item_kind" is not null and "reports"."item_key" is not null)
        or ("reports"."target_type" = 'senior_note' and "reports"."senior_note_id" is not null and "reports"."note_version" is not null)
        or ("reports"."target_type" = 'case_study' and "reports"."case_study_id" is not null and "reports"."case_study_version" is not null)
        or ("reports"."target_type" = 'profile' and "reports"."profile_user_id" is not null)
        or ("reports"."target_type"::text = 'community_space' and "reports"."community_space_id" is not null)
        or ("reports"."target_type"::text = 'community_post' and "reports"."community_post_id" is not null)
        or ("reports"."target_type"::text = 'community_comment' and "reports"."community_comment_id" is not null)
        or ("reports"."target_type"::text = 'community_recruitment' and "reports"."community_recruitment_id" is not null)
        or ("reports"."target_type"::text = 'community_application' and "reports"."community_application_id" is not null)
        or ("reports"."target_type"::text = 'course_qa' and "reports"."course_qa_item_id" is not null)
        or ("reports"."target_type"::text = 'persona' and "reports"."persona_id" is not null)
        or ("reports"."target_type"::text = 'profile_post' and "reports"."profile_post_id" is not null)
        or ("reports"."target_type"::text = 'social_link' and "reports"."social_link_id" is not null)

search_documents_target_check.name: search_documents_target_check
search_documents_target_check.value:
("search_documents"."kind" in ('case', 'stuck') and "search_documents"."publication_id" is not null and "search_documents"."release_id" is not null and "search_documents"."senior_note_id" is null
          and (("search_documents"."kind" = 'case') = ("search_documents"."item_key" is null)))
        or ("search_documents"."kind" = 'note' and "search_documents"."senior_note_id" is not null and "search_documents"."note_version" is not null and "search_documents"."publication_id" is null and "search_documents"."release_id" is null)
        or ("search_documents"."kind"::text = 'qa' and "search_documents"."course_qa_item_id" is not null and "search_documents"."publication_id" is null and "search_documents"."release_id" is null and "search_documents"."senior_note_id" is null)

senior_notes_term_label_check.name: senior_notes_term_label_check
senior_notes_term_label_check.value: "senior_notes"."term_label" is null or char_length("senior_notes"."term_label") between 1 and 30

usefulness_signals_target_check.name: usefulness_signals_target_check
usefulness_signals_target_check.value:
("usefulness_signals"."target_kind" = 'stuck_item' and "usefulness_signals"."publication_id" is not null and "usefulness_signals"."item_key" is not null and "usefulness_signals"."senior_note_id" is null and "usefulness_signals"."course_qa_item_id" is null)
        or ("usefulness_signals"."target_kind" = 'senior_note' and "usefulness_signals"."senior_note_id" is not null and "usefulness_signals"."publication_id" is null and "usefulness_signals"."item_key" is null and "usefulness_signals"."course_qa_item_id" is null)
        or ("usefulness_signals"."target_kind"::text = 'course_qa' and "usefulness_signals"."course_qa_item_id" is not null and "usefulness_signals"."publication_id" is null and "usefulness_signals"."item_key" is null and "usefulness_signals"."senior_note_id" is null)

users_real_name_check.name: users_real_name_check
users_real_name_check.value: "users"."real_name" is null or char_length("users"."real_name") between 1 and 30

weekly_checkins_note_check.name: weekly_checkins_note_check
weekly_checkins_note_check.value: "weekly_checkins"."note" is null or char_length("weekly_checkins"."note") between 1 and 200
